ideas.pitch: A telemetry viewer that records 1v1 coding duel performance metrics under pressure, providing post-match replay graphs of syntax changes, compilation failures, and time-to-solution.
ideas.problem_statement: CodeHive Community Duel Night: Live 1v1 coding duels — challenge another developer and solve coding problems head-to-head.
ideas.title: DuelAnalyzer: Real-Time Code Battle Telemetry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting a pain familiar to developers in the room by analyzing how people perform under high-pressure competitive conditions, similar to NFL data analysis wins.

ideas.pitch: An independent matchmaking and community Elo ranking companion web app for CodeHive duels, tracking historical head-to-head matchups and preferred languages.
ideas.problem_statement: CodeHive Community Duel Night: Real-time coding — compete directly on CodeHive and meet fellow developers.
ideas.title: PeerRank: Elo Rating & Matchmaking Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a concrete scheduling and community engagement problem for event participants, featuring an interface that works reliably live.

ideas.pitch: A shared real-time whiteboard and code snippet diff tool designed for duelists to review alternative solutions immediately after a match concludes.
ideas.problem_statement: CodeHive Community Duel Night: Meet fellow developers — connect with people who enjoy coding and problem-solving.
ideas.title: DuelNotes: Collaborative Post-Match Whiteboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates a working, real-time collaboration tool that directly enhances the post-duel social learning experience.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight micro-problem practice app customized with rapid-fire syntax drills to help participants prepare before entering a live CodeHive duel.
ideas.problem_statement: CodeHive Community Duel Night: Complete a test duel before the event so you're familiar with the platform.
ideas.title: KataDrill: Pre-Duel Warmup & Syntax Trainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the participant onboarding workflow, focusing on a polished experience that judges can test instantly.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser overlay and dashboard that displays active 1v1 match progress, test case pass rates, and live code diffs for community event streaming.
ideas.problem_statement: CodeHive Community Duel Night: Live 1v1 coding duels — challenge another developer and solve coding problems head-to-head.
ideas.title: DuelCast: Live Spectator Stream Overlay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Transforms solo viewing into an engaging spectator sport, providing immediate visual impact for live judging demonstrations.
